dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: 今日はご相談ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.origin: はじめに、年令、性別、ご相談内容をお聞かせ下さい
dialogue.content: To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 男性　30歳
dialogue.content: I'm a 30-year-old male.

dialogue.origin: 仕事がうまくいかないです。
dialogue.content: My work isn't going well.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: どんな風に上手くいかないと感じますか
dialogue.content: In what way do you feel it's not going well?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、うまくいかないというよりもやる気がでない。って感じかもしれません。
dialogue.content: Well, it's not so much that things aren't going well, but more like I lack motivation.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: やる気が出ないと思われたきっかけはありますか？
dialogue.content: Was there anything that made you feel unmotivated?

dialogue.origin: それがあまりわからなくて、、
dialogue.content: That's what I'm not really sure about...

dialogue.origin: いつ頃からそう感じるようになりましたか？
dialogue.content: When did you start feeling this way?

dialogue.origin: 何か力が抜けてしまったような、やる気出してまた頑張りたいなって思うんですけど
dialogue.content: It's like I've lost my drive. I want to feel motivated and work hard again, but...

dialogue.origin: 今年に入ってから調子が出なくて
dialogue.content: I haven't been feeling myself since the beginning of this year.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね昨年から今年になって、何かお仕事状況に変化がありましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. Has there been any change in your work situation between last year and this year?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、年末は繁忙期なので忙しく、年始から閑散期で一気に仕事が減るのでそれも原因かとは思うのですけど
dialogue.content: Yes, the end of the year is the busy season, so it's hectic, and then from the new year, it's the slow season and work drops off suddenly, so I think that might be a cause.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 毎年この期間も色々取り組んで先の事考えてたり前向きに活動していたんですけど
dialogue.content: Every year during this period, I used to tackle various things, think about the future, and be proactive,

dialogue.origin: どうも力がでなくて、一度相談してみたら何か変わるかな？って思いました。
dialogue.content: but I just can't seem to muster the energy, so I thought maybe consulting someone would make a difference.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそれはお辛いですよねやる気が出なくなって、仕事に支障は出ていますか
dialogue.content: I understand, that must be difficult for you. Has this lack of motivation affected your work?

dialogue.origin: 個人事業なので、やらない分だけ自分が損しますので、いずれ支障は出ると思います。
dialogue.content: Since I'm self-employed, if I don't work, I'm the one who loses out, so I think it will eventually become a problem.

dialogue.origin: なるほどやる気が出ない状態でも、仕事に特別おおきな影響は出ていませんか
dialogue.content: I see. So even with this lack of motivation, it hasn't had a particularly large impact on your work yet?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。状況は毎年同じなのに、違うのは自分の気持ち？ですね、、、何か活動しようにも後回しで結局2月も過ぎてしまったのでもう辞め時なのかもしれないと思うこともありました
dialogue.content: That's right. The situation is the same every year, but what's different is my own feelings, I guess... I keep procrastinating on things I should be doing, and before I knew it, February had passed. I've even thought maybe it's time to quit.

dialogue.origin: なるほど繁忙期と閑散期は一年で何度かあるのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you have busy and slow seasons several times a year?

dialogue.origin: はい、ちなみにもうすぐ繁忙期に入りますので多少は忙しくなります。
dialogue.content: Yes, and by the way, the busy season is starting soon, so things will get a bit busier.

dialogue.origin: それでまたやる気出たりするんでしょうけど、今回のだらけ具合は自分が心配になりましたので
dialogue.content: I'll probably get motivated again because of that, but the extent of my listlessness this time has me worried about myself.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね年末の時もですが、繁忙期には、物凄く頑張られているのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Like at the end of the year, you probably work extremely hard during the busy season, don't you?

dialogue.origin: 繁忙期はいつもそうなります。楽しいって気持ちも強いですし！閑散期との温度差はすごいので、、
dialogue.content: It's always like that during the busy season. I have a strong feeling of enjoyment, too! The difference in intensity compared to the off-season is huge...

dialogue.origin: 忙しい時に「楽しい」と思えることは素晴らしいと思います
dialogue.content: I think it’s wonderful that you can feel it’s “fun” when you’re busy.

dialogue.origin: これまで閑散期はどのように過ごされていましたか？
dialogue.content: How have you typically spent the slow seasons up until now?

dialogue.origin: それは好きな仕事なので！
dialogue.content: That’s because I love my work!

dialogue.origin: 色々準備したり、営業活動とか集客とかですね！やる気無くした時とかみんなどうしてるんでしょう？友人は正社員も多いので状況全然違うからわかってもらえないんですよね
dialogue.content: I would do various preparations, sales activities, customer acquisition, and so on. I wonder what everyone does when they lose motivation? Many of my friends are full-time employees, so their situations are completely different, and they don't really get it.

dialogue.origin: 好きなお仕事につけているのは素敵なことですね！
dialogue.content: It’s wonderful that you’re able to do work you love!

dialogue.origin: やる気をなくされた時の対処法は、きっと皆さんそれぞれの方法があるのかと思います
dialogue.content: I'm sure everyone has their own way of dealing with a loss of motivation.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.content: Thank you!

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、どういった対処法がありますか？
dialogue.content: Right. What kinds of coping methods are there?

dialogue.origin: 準備や営業活動や集客は今もされていますか？
dialogue.content: Are you still doing preparations, sales activities, and customer acquisition now?

dialogue.origin: 後回しにしながらたまに、って感じです。
dialogue.content: I do them occasionally, but I keep putting them off.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね今のお仕事に就かれて何年目になりますか？
dialogue.content: I see. How many years have you been in your current job?

dialogue.origin: 5年目です。今回だらけてしまったのは初めてなんです。
dialogue.content: This is my fifth year. This is the first time I've ever felt this sluggish.

dialogue.origin: これからがとても心配なります。
dialogue.content: I'm very worried about the future.

dialogue.origin: なるほど今までに経験したことのない気持ちや状態は、不安になりますよね
dialogue.content: I understand. Feelings and states you’ve never experienced before can be unsettling, can’t they?

dialogue.origin: はい、ほんとに。今年30歳になったのでこれからの自分の事考えたりするようにもなったので、それも原因かな。って今思いました。
dialogue.content: Yes, really. I turned 30 this year, so I've started thinking more about my future. I just realized that might be a reason too.

dialogue.origin: うんうんそうですよね勤続５年目となると、今のお仕事の流れには、だいぶ慣れてきているのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, that makes sense. Being in your fifth year, you've probably gotten quite used to the flow of your work by now, haven't you?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうだと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, I think so.

dialogue.origin: そうですよねお仕事にもある程度流れの余裕が出てきたことで、今のご自身の年齢のことや、色々考える時期、なのかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: Right. Now that you have a certain level of comfort with the workflow, perhaps it's a time for you to think about various things, like your current age.

dialogue.origin: なんだか色々考えるほど、疲れてしまいますね！
dialogue.content: Somehow, the more I think about various things, the more tired I get!

dialogue.origin: ほんとにそうだと思うます！
dialogue.content: I really think that's true!

dialogue.origin: それに気づかれたことは、素晴らしいと思いますよ
dialogue.content: I think it's wonderful that you've realized that.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、たしかに余裕が出てきたって言う考えもできますよね。
dialogue.content: Do you think so? It's true that I could see it as having more breathing room.

dialogue.origin: 恥ずかしながら現実的には余裕ではないんですけど、、精神的には慣れとかもあり流れがわかってるのである意味落ち着いてる。そんな感じもあるかもです。
dialogue.content: I'm embarrassed to say that in reality, I don't have much leeway, but mentally, because I'm used to it and know the flow, I'm calm in a sense. Maybe it's something like that.

dialogue.origin: うんうん　そうですよね例えば、今の営業活動や集客は支障が出ない程度に行いながら、これからのことを考える時間に使われるのも、あり、かもしれませんね
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm, that makes sense. For example, perhaps you could continue your current sales and customer acquisition activities just enough so they don't cause problems, and use the rest of the time to think about the future.

dialogue.origin: はい、色々考えすぎていたのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: Yes, maybe I've been overthinking things.

dialogue.origin: 提案ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for the suggestion.

dialogue.origin: また新たな発見ができるかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: You might make some new discoveries.

dialogue.origin: 良かったです！少しでもご不安が解消して頂けたのであれば、嬉しいです
dialogue.content: I'm glad! I'm happy if I was able to alleviate your anxiety even a little.

dialogue.origin: 新しい発見とかっていうのも5年目にして忘れていたようなものです。初心を忘れていたのかな。って思います。
dialogue.content: Making new discoveries... that's something I feel like I'd forgotten after five years. I think maybe I forgot my initial passion.

dialogue.origin: はい、話せて良かったって思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm glad I was able to talk about it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね初心を思い出すきっかけとなれたのであれば幸いです
dialogue.content: I'm glad if this has been an opportunity for you to remember that initial passion.

dialogue.origin: お話聞いていただきありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening to me!

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、お時間を頂きまして、ありがとうございましたご不安になった時は、またご相談にいらして下さいね
dialogue.content: No, thank you for your time. If you feel anxious again, please feel free to come back for another consultation.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうさせていただきます！
dialogue.content: Yes, I will!

dialogue.origin: では、本日のカウンセリングは、これにて終了とさせて頂きます。大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: Well then, we will conclude today's counseling session here. Is that all right?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine. Thank you very much!

dialogue.origin: はい　ありがとうございますでは、失礼いたします
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. Well then, goodbye.

dialogue.origin: (カウンセラー役お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました😊)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your hard work as the counselor. I appreciate it 😊)

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、相談役お疲れ様でしたありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Likewise, thank you for your hard work as the client.

dialogue.origin: ロールプレイを終了して大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: Is it okay to end the role-play?

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です。お疲れ様でした！
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine. Thank you for your work!

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様でした
dialogue.content: Thank you for your hard work.

topic.sub: やる気の低下とその対処法
